Khushi Choudhary

khushi.tech0@gmail.com | +91-8817470467 | +91-9685242352 | LinkedIn

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Full-Stack Developer (MERN) with 4+ years of experience designing backend systems and building responsive frontends.

Backend: Node.js, NestJS and Express APIs, event-driven microservices with Kafka, Redis caching,

MongoDB/PostgreSQL data modelling, and AWS cloud deployments. Frontend: React.js and Next.js applications with

TypeScript, Redux/RTK Query and TanStack Query, built on top of these backend services to deliver complete,

production-ready products end to end.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Backend

Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, REST APIs, GraphQL, Microservices, Kafka

Frontend

React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Redux / RTK Query, Zustand, TanStack Query

(React Query), SWR, Tailwind CSS, Material UI

Database

MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB Sharding

Cloud/DevOps

AWS (S3, CloudFront, Lambda, OpenSearch / ElasticSearch, EC2), Docker, Jenkins,

GitLab CI/CD, Firebase, Azure

Tools

Stripe, Shopify API, Jest, Swagger, Postman, Git

System Design

Load Balancing, Rate Limiting, Caching Strategies, Horizontal & Vertical Scaling,

Database Replication & Sharding, Message Queues, API Gateway, Circuit Breaker

Pattern

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Techahead Software PvtLtd | Noida

Jan 2026 – present

Software Engineer

Architected full-stack microservices with NestJS and Next.js on AWS; integrated Stripe, Kafka, and Firebase for real-

time event processing and notifications.

Configured Jenkins and Docker CI/CD pipelines for zero-downtime deployments on AWS EC2.

Hauper Technologies | Ahmedabad

Dec 2024 – Dec 2025

Full-Stack Developer

Delivered MERN stack applications with improved performance through MongoDB aggregation pipelines, Redis

caching, and REST API optimisations.

Streamlined CI/CD workflows using GitLab CI/CD with Jenkins and automated test pipelines.

Aimfortech Solution | Indore

Jan 2022 – Dec 2024

Software Developer

Maintained MERN applications serving 10,000+ users across Admin, HR, and Student modules with RTK Query and

TanStack Query state management.

• Reduced manual operational effort through third-party API integrations and workflow automation.

KEY PROJECTS

RMDY_ROOM — Patient-Provider Booking Platform

Jan 2026

Next.js · NestJS · MongoDB · Stripe · Firebase · AWS (S3, Lambda)

Healthcare platform with real-time chat, Stripe billing, Firebase notifications, admin approval workflows, and automated

slot management.

Tastebuddy Food — Food Ordering Platform

Jan 2026

NestJS · Microservices · MongoDB · Stripe · Redis · Kafka · Firebase · Webhooks

Event-driven, microservice-based food-ordering system with Kafka order processing, Redis caching, Stripe payments, and

real-time Firebase notifications.

Targus — Multi-Region E-Commerce

Aug 2022 – Dec 2024

Next.js · React.js · TypeScript · Redux / RTK Query · NestJS · Shopify API · MongoDB Sharding · AWS OpenSearch / Azure ElasticSearch

Enterprise platform managing 2M+ records across 6 regions; built responsive Next.js/React storefronts with Redux/RTK

Query state management on top of enterprise search, Shopify sync, and multi-language support.

Pegasus For Kids — E-Commerce & E-Skills Portal

Jan – Dec 2025

React.js · Redux · TypeScript · Material UI · Responsive UI · TanStack Query · Node.js · MongoDB · CI/CD

Built responsive React.js interfaces with Redux state management and Material UI components for catalog filtering, SEO-

optimised pages, and attendance tracking; backed by Node.js/MongoDB APIs for receipt generation and CI/CD pipelines.

EDUCATION & ACHIEVEMENTS

B.Tech — Information Technology, Jabalpur Engineering College

2019 – 2022

Best Lead Team Leader — 6 production projects delivered end-to-end.

LeetCode Top Percentile — 100+ DSA problems solved.
